sections.content: The subjunctive is not a tense (time), but a MOOD (attitude). While the indicative states facts (Carlos habla español), the subjunctive reflects wishes, possibilities, and subjective views. Take the 'yo' form of the present indicative, remove -o, and swap the vowel:

items.english: I hope that you speak with her.
I want you to eat well.
I wish that they live happily.

sections.content: Notice that the 'yo' and 'él/ella/usted' forms are always identical in the present subjunctive: yo hable, él hable.
